doc: 批1（病理2+感染1+HRP1+不良1）扩表源绑定：操作者按平台元数据(asset_data_sources 2026-10-24)与B01核验证据准备；对象全名显式，不拼不猜

pathology.driver: pymssql(容器实测2.3.11可用,pyodbc无libodbc不可用)
pathology.evidence: verify3more.json: dbo 两表 ID+datetime 锚点实存；平台库名=pitaya

infection.evidence: verify3more.json: C##FXPT 视图 VIEW + ID/DATETIME 实存；service=B01 hint orcl，试点连接即验

hrp.evidence: verify3more.json: HRPSEY656 视图 VIEW + ID/DATETIME 实存；service=B01 hint hrpdb，试点连接即验

adverse.evidence: B01台账 VERIFIED@mas（multi_source_verify 曾以库名 adverse_event 连接失败=Unknown database；库名按台账 mas 候选，试点前 SHOW DATABASES 核验）；视图名小写=台账 anchor views；锚点 EFFECTIVE_TIME
